newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific calls Pennzoil suit desperate.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific calls Pennzoil suit desperate.

text.p: Union Pacific Resources Group Inc said Wednesday it is unfazed by a suit filed against it by Pennzoil Co, which Union Pacific is seeking to acquire in a hostile $4 billion offer.

"This lawsuit is no surprise. It raises absolutely no issues that are an impediment to our offer," Union Pacific said in a statement Wednesday evening. "The lawsuit is a predictable and desperate measure by a management that refuses to address straightforwardly a very powerful and attractive offer we have made to Pennzoil shareholders."

Earlier Wednesday Pennzoil announced that it had filed a suit against Union Pacific in U.S. District Court in Delaware alleging that Union Pacific had failed to disclose earnings dilution resulting from the offer.
"In this litigation, there are absolutely no issues raised that are an impediment to our offer," Union Pacific spokesman Walter Montgomery said.
